title: 4-Step DDGAN Conditional Bimodal Reverse Chain
intuition: Harder Law 3B conditional reverse-diffusion test where x_0 is bimodal at (-0.75, 0) and (+0.75, 0), so reverse transitions from ambiguous central x_t values are genuinely multimodal rather than unimodal Gaussian.
failure_mode: Conditioned generator averages across the two branches at ambiguous x_t or starves low-density tail query strata, failing t1/t2 conditional CDF and mean checks.
protocol_notes: Tier-2 required public-API DDGAN task; exposes conditional fiber bias on multimodal posteriors.
